welcome.title: Welcome to Arenyxa v0.1
welcome.subtitle: Choose how you want to work first. This only changes workspace presentation and default navigation; it is not an authority level. Enterprise and developer identities are established through separate security flows.
welcome.scenario.title: Personal home scenario
welcome.scenario.hint: When Personal Mode is selected, Arenyxa uses this scenario to configure the first home view. All personal features remain available afterward.
welcome.enterprise.title: Enterprise & Operations
welcome.enterprise.description: Enterprise work mode provides local enterprise identity, device enrollment and trust, LAN coordination, and workspace governance. Creating an enterprise establishes a separate enterprise identity; joining an existing enterprise requires a one-time device enrollment credential from an administrator.
welcome.fleet.title: Fleet Control
welcome.fleet.description: View Enterprise Server, Distributed Worker, parallel Slots, Jobs, Leases, storage topology, and health in one place. Fleet Control exposes only authorized runtime and operations views and does not change Enterprise authority boundaries.
welcome.note: You can reopen this separate window later from Settings → Work Mode. Themes, fonts, scaling, and motion remain on the separate Personalization page.
welcome.profile.personal.title: General User · Simple Mode
welcome.profile.personal.summary: Use guided tasks for network analysis, security checks, API debugging, and data work.
welcome.profile.personal.detail.1: Hide unnecessary professional navigation and advanced parameters
welcome.profile.personal.detail.2: Does not change any security permission
welcome.profile.power.title: Advanced User
welcome.profile.power.summary: Reach analysis, recovery, and advanced tools faster.
welcome.profile.professional.title: Professional Work
welcome.profile.professional.summary: For long-running automation, workflows, and data engineering.
welcome.profile.professional.detail.1: Keep full diagnostics and recovery entry points discoverable
welcome.profile.professional.detail.2: Authority is still decided by the Security Kernel
welcome.profile.developer.title: Developer Profile
welcome.profile.developer.summary: For public APIs, the plugin SDK, and developer workflows.
welcome.profile.developer.detail.1: High-risk capabilities still require a separate risk agreement
welcome.profile.developer.detail.2: This is not Official Developer Access
welcome.profile.enterprise.title: Enterprise Work Mode
welcome.profile.enterprise.summary: Open enterprise administration, device enrollment, and enterprise runtime workspaces.
welcome.profile.enterprise.detail.0: Show create/join entry points when no enterprise identity exists
welcome.profile.enterprise.detail.1: Mode selection does not grant enterprise authority
welcome.profile.enterprise.detail.2: Specific capabilities remain governed by the Security Kernel
personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.subtitle: Themes, interface material, motion, and scaling; use Settings for system and enterprise configuration.
personalization.themes.title: Visual presets
personalization.themes.hint: Arenyxa visual presets affect appearance only; they do not change runtime behavior, permissions, storage, or enterprise policy.
personalization.motion.title: Material & motion
personalization.reduce_motion: Reduce large movement, refraction, particles, and continuous lighting effects
personalization.scale.title: Interface scale & typography
personalization.scale.hint: Automatic mode adjusts text and common control sizes according to Arenyxa's available window area while preserving Qt/Windows DPI scaling; Manual mode can be fixed from 85% to 160%.
personalization.scale.status_auto: Interface scaling updated: automatically follows window size
settings.page.title: Settings
settings.page.subtitle: System, language, performance, resource governance, diagnostics, and advanced maintenance
settings.experience.title: Work mode
settings.experience.hint: Work mode changes workspace presentation and default navigation only; it is not an authority level. Developer and Enterprise permissions are always decided by backend security policy; themes and presets remain on the separate Personalization page.
settings.experience.not_selected: Not selected; Welcome Center will open on the next launch
settings.common.revoked_audit_failed: The session was revoked, but writing the audit record failed.\n\n{error}
settings.performance.title: Performance & resource governance
settings.concurrency.title: Web capture concurrency
settings.concurrency.hint: Resource Governor can only tighten concurrency downward and cannot exceed these user-defined hard limits. It backs off under CPU, RAM, disk, or browser pressure; recovery requires consecutive healthy samples to avoid concurrency oscillation.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.advanced.title: Advanced settings & maintenance
settings.advanced.hint: Diagnostics, Repair Center, and Developer Mode are grouped here. Themes, motion, and interface scaling remain on the separate Personalization page.
settings.advanced.developer_experience: Developer Experience (interface preference only; does not grant Developer Authority)
settings.advanced.direct_shell: Direct Shell (PowerShell / CMD / Persistent Shell; Developer Mode only)
settings.advanced.direct_shell_tooltip: Full shells run with the current Windows user's permissions. High-risk commands still require additional confirmation and are recorded in terminal audit.
settings.diagnostics.not_run: Diagnostics have not been run in this session.
settings.diagnostics.include_paths: Include local paths in diagnostics bundle (off by default)
settings.reset.tooltip: Reset application settings and personalization preferences without deleting Projects, Captures, Exports, databases, or formal result data.
settings.official.title: Official Developer authorization
settings.official.hint: For Arenyxa official development and debugging capabilities. Login requires a .aryxdev Developer Login Bundle and a matching local Developer Personal Key Vault, followed by a one-time private-key challenge. Authentication grants only the capabilities explicitly listed in the certificate. This flow is separate from the public Developer Profile, Enterprise administrator authority, and Root Developer authority.
settings.root.title: Root Developer · Highest technical authority
settings.root.hint: For root-developer highest-authority debugging only. This flow uses an independent Root Owner identity bundle and device key for strong authentication, then performs the Root Integrity Challenge. It is not a normal Official Developer login and is not automatically granted by Enterprise administrator identity.
settings.root.login_tooltip: Highest-risk authority entry point; shown only when Developer Experience and Developer Mode are both enabled.
settings.status.performance_saved: Performance mode saved; thread-pool and full cache budgets will apply on the next launch.
settings.status.resource_saved: Resource-governance thresholds saved; full Governor thresholds and enabled state will apply on the next launch.

settings.direct_shell.dialog_info: This is not a security sandbox. Arenyxa retains process-tree termination, output budgets, sensitive-information redaction, and high-risk command prompts, but it cannot restrict permissions already held by the current user.
